data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 6.2m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013 GBP 3.5m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net release in prior-year claims of GBP 6.2m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 79.107m (gross). The reported movement is stated on a net basis only; no gross prior-year movement figure is provided in the notes. The release likely reflects favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries relating to prior years (principally the 2013 year).
